## Summary

The spec requires the create-owner response to carry `bulkSignupWarning: true` when more than 80 owners were already created today, else `false`. I implemented it following the OfficeFloor function-injection conventions, keeping structural impact low:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a `bulkSignupWarning` boolean (readOnly) to the `Owner` response schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field and MapStruct auto-maps it by name (no mapper change needed).

2. **`Owner.java`** — added a `@Transient boolean bulkSignupWarning` field with a plain getter/setter (two new one-line accessors, no existing method touched). It's transient, so no DB schema change and a freshly loaded owner (e.g. on GET) defaults to `false`.

3. **`FlagBulkSignup.java`** (new small step) — counts existing owners registered today and sets the flag when `count > 80`, mirroring the existing `CheckDailyLimit` counting style. It runs before `SaveOwner`, so the count excludes the owner being created.

4. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted the `flagBulkSignup` step into the pipeline (after `countNamesakes`, before `save`), under the same `transaction` governance as its neighbours.

The new acceptance test (`bulkSignupWarning` false on a fresh create, read back via GET) and the full build pass green.
